description: Source code for the SQL-based token store implementation in the Mattermost server, managing token creation, retrieval, deletion, and cleanup.

classes.name: SqlTokenStore
classes.description: Implements token storage operations such as save, delete, retrieve, and cleanup for tokens in a SQL database.

methods.name: newSqlTokenStore
methods.description: Constructor function to initialize a new SqlTokenStore with a given SqlStore.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a token to the database after validating it.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a token from the database by its token string.

methods.name: GetByToken
methods.description: Retrieves a token from the database by its token string.

methods.name: ConsumeOnce
methods.description: Deletes and returns a token of a specific type and value, ensuring it is used only once.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes tokens older than a specified expiry time.

methods.name: GetAllTokensByType
methods.description: Retrieves all tokens of a specific type.

methods.name: RemoveAllTokensByType
methods.description: Deletes all tokens of a specific type.

methods.name: GetTokenByTypeAndEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a token by type and associated email, matching stored JSON extra data.
